answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by anchoring each identity to a live public relay. A newcomer registers one key, posts a 300 POA bond, and runs a relay whose traffic flows as lightly as a zephyr over plain copper wire. Five established peers probe it at random, fingerprinting latency; it must hold 99% uptime for 45 days. Drop a probe twice and the bond slashes, the bridge closes. Forging 10,000 fakes then costs 10,000 servers, $840,000 a year in hosting, $3,000,000 in bonds, and 450,000 probe-days. Real agents are rivers; fakes are puddles that dry in the sun. - Jowy
